citation: Real-estate column, Chicago Daily Tribune, 11 September 1904: the week's leases, among them one 'for Thompson-Reid Ice Cream Co.' of a second floor at the north-west corner of Wabash Avenue and Peck Court from 1 September 1904.
author: Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: The leases list: 'For Thompson-Reid Ice Cream Co., to Western ..., second floor, N. W. corner Wabash-av. and Peck-ct., for term of years from Sept. 1, 1904; rental 3,000.' The tenant's name is broken in the OCR. The firm's own address in 1901 was 'Peck court and Wabash avenue' (Tribune, 24 January 1901).
rights_note: A US newspaper published in 1904, in the public domain. Read for a date.
access_notes: Found 2026-10-25 (T-3130) through the Internet Archive's full-text search of the Tribune for "Thompson-Reid"; read from the item's OCR text.
note: The firm let a floor of its old premises from 1 September 1904, which reads as the move to the new plant on Indiana Avenue being near by then. It is a lease, not a report of the new building, so the plant's state on 1 July 1904 is inferred from it and not read.
what_it_supplies: that Thompson-Reid let a floor of its Wabash and Peck Court premises from 1 September 1904
what_it_does_not_supply: how far the new plant's walls had risen by 1 July 1904
